Two advertisement blocks appear on this page (September 1926, *The Anglo-Swiss Commercial Gazette*, p. 15):

1. **"Die Britische Industrie-Messe 1927"** – British Industries Fair advertisement (White City, London & Castle Bromwich, Birmingham, 21 Feb–4 Mar 1927), including the two dotted "KÄUFER" boxes.
   Bounding box: [190, 332, 2142, 1720]

2. **"Application for Admission to Membership"** – British Chamber of Commerce for Switzerland membership solicitation form (Basle, 20 Rittergasse), including the subscription note.
   Bounding box: [184, 1762, 2149, 3115]
